note: The catalog compares possibilities. This lab does not install or invoke any listed application. No source code is copied or relicensed.

tools.assessment: Strong PC execution model; current remote channel outage is the problem to bypass.
Useful reference for supervised remote shell, service and desktop management; deployment is more complex.
Good manual fallback for screen and keyboard, not a ChatGPT command API. Relays or reachable network still required.
Best for browser access to existing RDP/VNC/SSH servers; separate infrastructure required.
Potential manual cloud fallback; not independent of Internet.
Useful for real-time video/audio evaluation, not filesystem/task automation.
Companion to Sunshine for graphical streaming.
Reverse direction: controls phone from PC. Valuable for Android testing but not PC control from ChatGPT.

boundaries: No vendor application is silently installed, cloned or exposed as an automatic shell.
Third-party protocols do not magically expose a supported ChatGPT connector.
A USB cable without networking or ADB is not equivalent to a bidirectional command channel.
Every field claim requires Windows + actual target Android device evidence.
Licenses of each upstream project must be reviewed before reusing code.
